# Pine & Dandy

> Two cozy lakefront vacation cabins in Wisconsin's Northwoods near Eagle River — The O.G. on Lake Arbutus and The Grandy Dandy on the Sugar Camp Chain. Retro charm, modern comfort, lake out the door.

Pine & Dandy offers year-round cabin rentals 10–15 minutes from downtown Eagle River, Vilas County, Wisconsin. Both cabins include kayaks, a hot tub, and direct lake access.

## The cabins
- The O.G. — lakefront on Lake Arbutus
- The Grandy Dandy — on the Sugar Camp Chain of lakes
- Both: hot tub, kayaks, sleep the whole group, open year-round

## The area (Eagle River / Northwoods)
- Snowmobile Capital of the World; World Championship Snowmobile Derby each January
- The world's largest inland chain of freshwater lakes; renowned musky fishing
- Four-season: summer (boating, swimming, fishing), fall (color), winter (snowmobiling, ice fishing), spring (fishing opener)

## Content — The Northwoods Journal (/journal)
- Local guides: fall color, snowmobiling, fishing, supper clubs & dining, family activities, seasonal trip planning
